list.name: org_id
list.label: Org
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT org_id::text FROM campaigns ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(a.weighted_mean) AS avg_score FROM aggregated_scores a JOIN content_variants v ON v.id = a.variant_id JOIN campaigns c ON c.id = v.campaign_id WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND ('$org_id' = 'All' OR c.org_id::text = '$org_id')

SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN a.any_critical_violation THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS violation_rate FROM aggregated_scores a JOIN content_variants v ON v.id = a.variant_id JOIN campaigns c ON c.id = v.campaign_id WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND ('$org_id' = 'All' OR c.org_id::text = '$org_id')

SELECT AVG(a.variance) AS avg_variance FROM aggregated_scores a JOIN content_variants v ON v.id = a.variant_id JOIN campaigns c ON c.id = v.campaign_id WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND ('$org_id' = 'All' OR c.org_id::text = '$org_id')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS scored FROM aggregated_scores a JOIN content_variants v ON v.id = a.variant_id JOIN campaigns c ON c.id = v.campaign_id WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND ('$org_id' = 'All' OR c.org_id::text = '$org_id')

SELECT $__timeGroup(a.created_at, '1h') AS time, AVG(a.weighted_mean) AS avg_score FROM aggregated_scores a JOIN content_variants v ON v.id = a.variant_id JOIN campaigns c ON c.id = v.campaign_id WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND ('$org_id' = 'All' OR c.org_id::text = '$org_id') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT (LEAST(width_bucket(a.weighted_mean, 0, 100, 10), 10) * 10 - 10)::text || '-' || (LEAST(width_bucket(a.weighted_mean, 0, 100, 10), 10) * 10)::text AS score_range, COUNT(*) AS variants FROM aggregated_scores a JOIN content_variants v ON v.id = a.variant_id JOIN campaigns c ON c.id = v.campaign_id WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND ('$org_id' = 'All' OR c.org_id::text = '$org_id') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT v.channel, AVG(a.weighted_mean) AS avg_score FROM aggregated_scores a JOIN content_variants v ON v.id = a.variant_id JOIN campaigns c ON c.id = v.campaign_id WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND ('$org_id' = 'All' OR c.org_id::text = '$org_id') GROUP BY v.channel ORDER BY avg_score DESC

SELECT COALESCE(v.generation_model,'unknown') AS model, AVG(a.weighted_mean) AS avg_score FROM aggregated_scores a JOIN content_variants v ON v.id = a.variant_id JOIN campaigns c ON c.id = v.campaign_id WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND ('$org_id' = 'All' OR c.org_id::text = '$org_id') GROUP BY v.generation_model ORDER BY avg_score DESC

SELECT b.judge_model, AVG(b.composite_score) AS avg_score, COUNT(*) AS evaluations FROM brand_scores b JOIN content_variants v ON v.id = b.variant_id JOIN campaigns c ON c.id = v.campaign_id WHERE $__timeFilter(b.created_at) AND ('$org_id' = 'All' OR c.org_id::text = '$org_id') GROUP BY b.judge_model ORDER BY avg_score DESC

SELECT a.routing_decision, COUNT(*) AS n FROM aggregated_scores a JOIN content_variants v ON v.id = a.variant_id JOIN campaigns c ON c.id = v.campaign_id WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND ('$org_id' = 'All' OR c.org_id::text = '$org_id') GROUP BY a.routing_decision ORDER BY n DESC
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM review_requests WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND ('$org_id' = 'All' OR org_id::text = '$org_id') GROUP BY status ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN v.reflexion_applied THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS reflexion_rate, AVG(v.retry_count) AS avg_retries, AVG(v.back_translation_score) AS avg_back_translation FROM content_variants v JOIN campaigns c ON c.id = v.campaign_id WHERE $__timeFilter(v.created_at) AND ('$org_id' = 'All' OR c.org_id::text = '$org_id')

SELECT v.campaign_id::text AS campaign_id, COUNT(a.*) AS variants, ROUND(AVG(a.weighted_mean), 1) AS avg_score, ROUND(AVG(a.variance), 1) AS avg_variance, SUM(CASE WHEN a.any_critical_violation THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS violations FROM aggregated_scores a JOIN content_variants v ON v.id = a.variant_id JOIN campaigns c ON c.id = v.campaign_id WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND ('$org_id' = 'All' OR c.org_id::text = '$org_id') GROUP BY v.campaign_id ORDER BY avg_score ASC LIMIT 100
